docs: app overview instead of map, Oliver as sole owner

## Intent

lernapps/.github still names the map and two owners, because the earlier session could not reach this repo. It should match the docs: the app overview replaces the map, and Oliver Jägle is the sole owner.

## Key changes

- ORGANIZATION.md: apps (lernapps.net/apps/) replaces map in the repo table, in how to reach us, in the rules across repos and in the license table; map is being retired; docs holds biz42 and pdt42.
- GOVERNANCE.md: one owner, accountable for the platform; Ralf is the author of the Mathe-Karte and does not take part in the platform, as in biz42 chapter 8.
- CONTRIBUTING.md, the issue chooser and the org profile send people who list an app to lernapps.net/apps/eintragen/ instead of issues in map.
